lines.en: I walk very much like a person.
This body does not quite obey me.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖朝后弯了一下。
lines.en: My knee bent backward for a moment.

lines.zh: 我踩进你留下的每个坑。
lines.en: I set my feet in every print you left.

lines.zh: 衣角下露出的不是皮肤。
lines.en: What shows below my hem is not skin.

lines.zh: 我走得比人还稳，这不正常。
lines.en: I walk steadier than a person should.

lines.zh: 头转得太快了，我修一下。
lines.en: My head turned too fast; I fix it.
I copy the length of your stride.

lines.zh: 影子投在墙上，不太像人。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is not quite human.
I keep to the edge of the corridor.
My arms hang too long.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把肩膀接回去。
lines.en: I stop and pop my shoulder back in.
I stand still, my face unmoving.
I am practicing breathing.
Something pushes from inside this skin.
I tilt my head at a slightly wrong angle.
I stare at the lamp without blinking.

lines.zh: 我把嘴合上了，刚才开太大。
lines.en: I close my mouth; it had opened too wide.
I am learning how you speak.

lines.zh: 我的下巴轻轻响了一下。
lines.en: My jaw clicked once.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势，你别看太久。
lines.en: I will hold this pose; don't stare too long.
You and I look very much alike.
I try to smile; it comes out wrong.
What is your name? I want to remember it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脸，看得很细。
lines.en: I study your face in detail.
Hold still while I match myself to you.
Your eyes are rounder than mine.

lines.zh: 我抬手，跟你打了个招呼。
lines.en: I lift a hand and wave at you.
I remember your voice.

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，我关上了。
lines.en: That door behind you — I closed it.
I am looking for the softest part of you.
The skin tore a little. I will patch it.

lines.zh: 你打到我，我不太明白为什么。
lines.en: You hit me, and I don't quite understand why.
One joint fell out of step.
This body feels pain.

lines.zh: 我扶正肩膀，脸还是没表情。
lines.en: I set my shoulder straight; my face stays blank.
I know you are afraid of me now.

lines.zh: 这一节软骨滑出了原位。
lines.en: A piece of cartilage slid out of place.
Don't hit my face.
I back off and press the skin back.
I will remember the strength of that blow.

lines.zh: 你带来的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell what you brought.
I am not good at eating, but I can try.
Hand it over; I won't bite you.

lines.zh: 这个东西，我以前也吃过。
lines.en: I have eaten this before, long ago.
My throat moves strangely.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我吃相不好。
lines.en: Step back a bit; I eat badly.
I open my mouth the way you do.

lines.zh: 手指沾到味道，我舔了一下。
lines.en: It got on my finger; I licked it.

lines.zh: 别看我怎么把这口咽下去。
lines.en: Don't watch me swallow this.
I eat slowly. Wait.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，我接住了。
lines.en: You bumped into me; I caught you.
My body is softer than it looks.
Don't push; my joints click.
We collide, and I go crooked.
My hand steadies your back.
That foot is mine. Move.

lines.zh: 我撞到墙上，掉了一点皮。
lines.en: I hit the wall and shed a little skin.
I step back and set my shoulder straight.

lines.zh: 贴近的时候，别看我脖子。
lines.en: When we are this close, don't look at my neck.
I bump lightly; I might come apart.
You are very like me. That is good.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你肩上，学着温柔。
lines.en: I place my hand on your shoulder, imitating gentleness.
I can stay with you the whole time.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我学得很像。
lines.en: When you speak, I copy it well.

lines.zh: 我睁着眼也能等到天亮。
lines.en: I can wait till dawn with my eyes open.

lines.zh: 你靠着我，别管我的呼吸。
lines.en: Lean on me; ignore my breathing.

lines.zh: 我会记住你所有的习惯。
lines.en: I will remember all your habits.
Let me come closer. Is that all right?
My hands are cold; bear with it.

lines.zh: 我们一直在一起，一直到很久。
lines.en: We stay together for a very long time.
I will take this.
Bending down does not go smoothly.

lines.zh: 它在你手里，也在我手里。
lines.en: It was in your hand, and now in mine.
I keep it; it may be useful.

lines.zh: 这层皮下没有骨头的感觉。
lines.en: Under this skin there's no feeling of bone.
I picked up two. One is for you.
I slide it into my sleeve.
If you drop it, I pick it up faster.
I am taking this scent back with me.

lines.zh: 我先看看，再决定收不收。
lines.en: I look first, then decide whether to keep it.
I know you now.
I straighten my head toward you.
No need to run; I never tire.
This skin is finally useful.
I want to see what is inside you.

lines.zh: 你身上有我喜欢的气味。
lines.en: You carry a scent I like.
I tighten all my joints.
The door is locked. I locked it.

lines.zh: 你刚才看到我的样子了。
lines.en: You saw what I really look like.
Now it is only the two of us.

lines.zh: 我走近一步，皮就绷一下。
lines.en: Each step I take tightens the skin.

lines.zh: 我听得出你咽了口口水。
lines.en: I can hear you swallow.
Don't shout; no one is here.

lines.zh: 我学你的声音，学得很像。
lines.en: I can copy your voice very well.

lines.zh: 这层皮我穿了很久，就为现在。
lines.en: I have worn this skin a long time for this.

lines.zh: 你看见我手上有几根手指吗？
lines.en: Did you count my fingers?

lines.zh: 你躲到桌子后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind the table; I go around.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，脚步声跟你一样。
lines.en: I hug the wall, steps matching yours.
I let my arms out a little.
There is no second door in that corner.
I have copied down the smell of your sweat.
The door is there, and I will not allow it.
One, two — faster and faster.
I do not need to run.
You are already surrounded by me.

lines.zh: 我把脸正过来，怕吓着你。
lines.en: I straighten my face so as not to scare you.
The light is dimming. Good.
One more step.

lines.zh: 你身后有人影，那是我的手。
lines.en: The shape behind you is my hand.
You looked back.
You stepped on your own heel.
Back up more and you hit the wall.
I stay silent, and you fear it more.

lines.zh: 吊灯很稳，我在上面待过。
lines.en: The chandelier is steady; I have been up there.
If I move first, you won't see it.
You needn't look up.
I reach out and seize your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的手臂伸得太长。
lines.en: This blow — my arm stretched too far.
The wall is cold, and so is my palm.
I am stronger than you expect.
I tear your collar open.
Don't struggle; I will come apart.
My fingers sink into your shoulder.
I strike lightly; I don't want to break you.
I land a palm on your back.
A little pressure and you cry out.
I step back half a pace; my joints creak.

lines.zh: 我这层皮下面没有骨头的规矩。
lines.en: Under this skin, bones follow no rules.
I headbutt you.
My face shows nothing. Sorry.
I have you, and I won't let go.
You knocked my hand askew.
I press down on your throat.
I did not hold back on that one.
The smell of blood is very familiar.

lines.zh: 等一下，我的手要滑下来了。
lines.en: Wait — my hand is slipping off.
I rise from the corner.
I copy the first person I saw walking.
The door opened by itself. It was me.
This body is too big.
I set my face straight, for the first time.
There is a human scent in this house.
I try to speak and nothing comes.

lines.zh: 墙上有镜子，我看了很久。
lines.en: There is a mirror on the wall; I looked a long time.
My first step lands heavily.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，我能看清你的脸。
lines.en: The lamp's still lit; I can see your face.

lines.zh: 我数了数房间里有几个人。
lines.en: I count how many people are in the room.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进你的衣服里。
lines.en: I fit myself into your clothes.
Fire touches this skin and it curls.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我一节一节散了。
lines.en: I fall and come apart joint by joint.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我里面的东西浮起来了。
lines.en: Water pours in and what is inside me floats.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我整个人翻过去。
lines.en: A blast flips me over entirely.

lines.zh: 有东西穿透了我，我能看见它。
lines.en: Something passed through me; I can see it.

lines.zh: 紫色的光照进来，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Violet light enters me and I curl up.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我撑不住这层皮。
lines.en: Too long without food; I cannot hold this skin.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身的关节一起跳。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every joint jumps.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我还在往下。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I keep going down.
